channel.title: imal1ice — who controls your protocol
channel.description: Notes on who really controls DeFi protocols: owners, admins, Safe signers, timelocks and upgrade gates.

item.title: I read who controls 36 DeFi protocols. Here's the scoreboard.
item.description: Between 14 and 26 October I read the admin setup of 36 mid-size DeFi protocols from the chain. Ten put a privileged role on a single key; sixteen run a Safe with no timelock; eight were genuinely well run. The numbers, and what they mean.

item.title: The control plane is the attack surface nobody maps
item.description: Code gets audited; the owners, proxy admins, Safe signers, timelocks and upgrade gates above it almost never do — and that's the part that can replace the audited code in one transaction. How to read who really controls a protocol.
